tools.name: list_reason_codes
tools.description: Lists the Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover chargeback reason codes that representments.com explains, each with its plain-English name and a link to the full page. Pass a network to see only its codes.

tools.name: lookup_reason_code
tools.description: Explains one chargeback reason code: what the customer claimed, the proof that wins, the situations it usually comes from, and a link to the full page. Accepts forms such as 13.1, Visa 10.4, 4853 or C08.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Prices for representments.com in US dollars: the free first response, the two monthly plans, and per-case work for a single chargeback of $10,000 or more.

tools.name: get_help_with_a_dispute
tools.description: For a merchant with a chargeback open now. Explains how to get a custom response to it, with the first one free. Pass the reason code if you know it.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_help_with_a_dispute" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
